places.name: West Edmonton Mall
places.ai_summary: West Edmonton Mall is the largest shopping mall in North America, featuring shops, attractions, and entertainment options.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the World Waterpark and Galaxyland inside the mall.

attribution.author: GoToVan from Vancouver, Canada

places.name: Muttart Conservatory
places.ai_summary: The Muttart Conservatory is a botanical garden featuring four glass pyramids with unique plant collections.
places.place_tip: Check for seasonal exhibits and events.

attribution.title: Muttart Conservatories Edmonton Alberta Canada 01A
attribution.author: WinterE229 WinterforceMedia

places.name: Royal Alberta Museum
places.ai_summary: The Royal Alberta Museum showcases Alberta’s natural and cultural history through interactive exhibits and galleries.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Natural History Hall.

attribution.description: Viewing the west entrance of the building and the Children's Gallery from outside.

places.name: Elk Island National Park
places.ai_summary: Elk Island National Park is a protected area known for its bison, elk, and diverse bird species.
places.place_tip: Visit the Bison Loop and take a hike on one of the many trails.
places.address: Range Rd 203, Fort Saskatchewan, Alberta, Canada

places.name: Fort Edmonton Park
places.ai_summary: Fort Edmonton Park is a historical park that recreates Edmonton's past with interactive exhibits and costumed interpreters.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and Tuesdays in the off-season.

places.place_tip: Take the time to explore all the historical exhibits and buildings.

places.name: Art Gallery of Alberta
places.ai_summary: The Art Gallery of Alberta is an art museum that houses a significant collection of Canadian and international art.
places.place_tip: Check out the rotating exhibitions and the museum shop.
places.address: 2 Sir Winston Churchill Square, Edmonton, Alberta, Canada

places.name: Whyte Avenue
places.ai_summary: Whyte Avenue is a historic street known for its vibrant arts scene, boutique shops, and diverse dining options.

opening_hours.notes: Many shops and restaurants have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets and alleys for unique finds.
places.address: Whyte Ave NW, Edmonton, Alberta, Canada

attribution.title: Whyte (82) Av
attribution.author: Own work
attribution.description: Whyte (82) Avenue sign, at 104 Street.

places.name: TELUS World of Science - Edmonton
places.ai_summary: TELUS World of Science - Edmonton is a science museum with interactive exhibits, a planetarium, and an IMAX theatre.
places.place_tip: Check out the IMAX schedule and plan your visit around a show.

attribution.title: Space-and-Science-Centre-Edmonton-Alberta
attribution.author: WinterforceMedia(WinterE229)
attribution.description: The main building of the Space and Science Centre in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.

places.name: Edmonton River Valley Parks
places.ai_summary: The Edmonton River Valley Parks system is a network of parks and trails along the North Saskatchewan River, offering recreational opportunities and scenic views.

opening_hours.notes: Some facilities may have seasonal hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the trails by bike or on foot, and don’t miss the view from the river valley lookout.

places.name: Legislature Building
places.ai_summary: The Alberta Legislature Building is the home of the Legislative Assembly of Alberta and is known for its impressive architecture and beautiful grounds.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the history and architecture.

attribution.title: Alberta Legislature Building, June 7, 2024

places.name: Rogers Place
places.ai_summary: Rogers Place is a multi-purpose arena that hosts concerts, sports events, and other entertainment activities.
places.place_tip: Check the event schedule and book tickets in advance for popular shows.

attribution.title: Rogers Place, Edmonton, June 6, 2024
attribution.author: <bdi>D. Benjamin Miller</bdi>
attribution.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication

places.name: High Level Bridge Streetcar
places.ai_summary: The High Level Bridge Streetcar is a historic streetcar that offers a scenic ride across the North Saskatchewan River.
places.place_tip: Ride the streetcar to the end of the line and back for the full experience.
places.address: Grierson Hill Rd, Edmonton, Alberta, Canada

places.name: Ukrainian Cultural Heritage Village
places.ai_summary: The Ukrainian Cultural Heritage Village is an open-air museum that preserves and promotes Ukrainian-Canadian history and culture.
places.place_tip: Participate in a guided tour to learn about the exhibits and history.

places.name: Edmonton Valley Zoo
places.ai_summary: The Edmonton Valley Zoo is a zoo that focuses on the conservation of species and offers interactive animal experiences.
places.place_tip: Visit the interactive exhibits and attend the animal feedings.
places.address: 13315 Buena Vista Rd, Edmonton, Alberta, Canada

places.name: World Waterpark
places.ai_summary: World Waterpark is an indoor water park located within West Edmonton Mall, featuring water slides, a wave pool, and a lazy river.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary on holidays and school breaks.

places.place_tip: Bring your own towel and arrive early to avoid long lines.

attribution.title: World Waterpark 2015
attribution.author: Rowanswiki
attribution.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication

places.name: Galaxyland
places.ai_summary: Galaxyland is an indoor amusement park located within West Edmonton Mall, featuring rides and attractions for all ages.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary on holidays and school breaks.

places.place_tip: Purchase a wristband for unlimited rides and arrive early to enjoy all attractions.

attribution.title: West Edmonton Mall, Edmonton, Alberta (21485641783)
attribution.author: GoToVan from Vancouver, Canada

places.name: Neon Sign Museum
places.ai_summary: The Neon Sign Museum is an outdoor museum showcasing a collection of historic neon signs from Edmonton's past.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed at night when the signs are lit.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and explore the area at night for the best experience.

places.name: Hawrelak Park
places.ai_summary: Hawrelak Park is a large urban park in Edmonton's River Valley, offering trails, picnic areas, and a lake for boating.

opening_hours.notes: Some facilities may have seasonal hours.

places.place_tip: Rent a paddleboat or canoe to enjoy the lake.
places.address: 9330 Groat Rd NW, Edmonton, Alberta, Canada

places.name: Old Strathcona Farmers' Market
places.ai_summary: The Old Strathcona Farmers' Market is a popular market featuring local produce, crafts, and food vendors.

opening_hours.notes: Open Friday to Sunday, closed on holidays.

places.place_tip: Arrive early for the best selection of fresh produce.

places.name: Francis Winspear Centre for Music
places.ai_summary: The Francis Winspear Centre for Music is a concert hall in Edmonton, known for its excellent acoustics and diverse musical performances.
places.place_tip: Check the schedule for performances and book tickets in advance.
places.address: 4 Sir Winston Churchill Square, Edmonton, Alberta, Canada
